schema.title: Conditional
schema.description: Synthetic: when status is DONE, label must be a string and code must not be all x.

schema.title: ConditionalTwoKeys
schema.description: Synthetic: when status is DONE and kind is A, label must be a string.

Conditional.title: Conditional
Conditional.description: Synthetic: when status is DONE, label must be a string and code must not be all x.

schema.title: NumberBounds
schema.description: Synthetic: numbers with inclusive bounds and an exclusive minimum.

schema.title: BooleanConst
schema.description: Synthetic: booleans fixed to one value.

schema.title: ArrayLength
schema.description: Synthetic: arrays with a minimum and a maximum length.

schema.title: MapKeys
schema.description: Synthetic: maps with free, non-empty and enumerated keys.

schema.title: ConditionalElse
schema.description: Synthetic: when status is DONE, label is a string; otherwise label is null and code is not all x.

schema.title: ConditionalNull
schema.description: Synthetic: exactly one of a and b is null.

schema.title: ConditionalInteger
schema.description: Synthetic: with n 0 the stats are null and items is empty; otherwise the stats are numbers and items is not empty.

schema.title: ConditionalAllOf
schema.description: Synthetic: a distance entry whose value, reason, spread and tie flag depend on its status and spread.

schema.title: IntegerConst
schema.description: Synthetic: tile_px is the integer 512, as pydantic emits Literal[512].

schema.title: DiscriminatedUnion
schema.description: Synthetic: legend is a ClassesLegend or a NumericLegend chosen by kind, as pydantic emits a discriminated union.

schema.title: DiscriminatedUnionNullable
schema.description: Synthetic: legend is a discriminated union or null, as pydantic emits the union with None.
